about_lead.text: — a full-stack application developer and robotics enthusiast who wants to explore every tech out there.

about_paragraphs: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from BRAC University. Alongside my work in robotics and automation, I'm dedicated to exploring machine vision, machine learning, and full-stack software development.

As co-founder of Dubotech Digital I ship web platforms end to end. I also serve as a Robotics Instructor at BRAC University's Residential Campus, sharing my knowledge and enthusiasm with the next generation of innovators.
